english:
<solar Solar /> Weapon Damage applies 30 stacks of <solar Scorch /> (45 with <solar Ember of Ashes />) to Combatants with no Scorch stacks while <solar Radiant />.

<solar Solar /> effects that Kindling Trigger starts do not benefit from Weapon or Ability Damage increases.

Does not work inside a Well of Radiance.

Has a 0.3 second cooldown between triggers.

source.text:
While Radiant:

Solar Weapon Damage inflicts x30+15 Scorch to Combatants without Scorch stacks.

Solar Effects initially triggered by Kindling Trigger do not benefit from Weapon nor Ability Damage increases.

Does not work while within a Well of Radiance. 
Incurs a 0.3 second cooldown upon triggering.
